summary: Vishay Intertechnology filed an 8-K announcing it notified holders of its 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2030 that the notes have become convertible during the quarter ending October 3, 2026. The notes are convertible into cash up to the aggregate principal amount, with any excess conversion obligation payable in cash, shares of common stock, or a combination at Vishay's election. This is a routine notice of convertibility, not a special situation such as a tender offer or restructuring. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event is involved. No transaction is proposed or executed; this is an administrative update on existing convertible notes. No risk-arb angle exists.
